settings.label: DeskPaws product
settings.info: The product the whole film sells. Its first available variant is used for the Get DeskPaws button and JSON-LD.

settings.label: Enable the cinematic 3D stage
settings.info: When off, the site shows the fully-purchasable static cut (posters + copy). Reduced-motion and no-WebGL visitors always get the static cut.

settings.label: Model + texture base URL
settings.info: Folder holding deskpaws_desktop_FINAL.glb, deskpaws_mobile_FINAL.glb and fur_gray_*.webp. Defaults to the public repo via jsDelivr; you can point it at a Shopify Files folder.

settings.label: Fur render level

options.label: c — baked fur, no ribbons (clean grey)

settings.info: Decision tree from the build spec §3.5.6. Level c is safest; try b on real hardware.

settings.content: Paste Shopify Files CDN URLs (Content → Files). Empty fields render labelled placeholders — the site stays fully functional.
